_comment: Controlled vocabulary for the `custom:` block of every policy's `# METADATA` annotation. check_metadata.py enforces it. Add a value here (with a PR) before using it in a policy.

class.security: Configuration baseline for a platform (CIS, STIG, SCuBA, PSS, supply-chain). Loads into opa-security.
class.compliance: Regulatory, legal or management framework (NIST, ISO, PCI, GDPR, SOC 2, ...). Loads into opa-compliance.
class.ot: Operational-technology / critical-infrastructure framework (NERC-CIP, IEC 62443, AMI, TSA). Loads into opa-ot.
class.governance: Cross-cutting governance (AI, FinOps, MCP, OIDC, exceptions). Loads into opa-compliance AND opa-ot.
class.enforcement: Policy-as-code gatekeeper that blocks a change or a job (Ansible, Terraform, AAP, git). Loads into opa-compliance.
class.threat-detection: Behavioural indicator, not a control. Loads into opa-ot.
